Name: Philetus
Summary: Philetus is named in 2 Timothy with Hymenaeus as one whose word ate as a canker, teaching that the resurrection was past already and overthrowing the faith of some.
KeyStory: Philetus is named in 2 Timothy with Hymenaeus as one whose word ate as a canker, teaching that the resurrection was past already and overthrowing the faith of some.
LifeLesson: Error spreads quietly; naming it plainly protects the faith of others.
